---
title: "Chapter 3 - Macro/Micro - Chi-square & Frequency - Within Tool Class - Machete"
output: word_document
date: "2026-07-12"
---

```{r}
library(DescTools)
Macro_Micro_Data_Machete<-read.csv("Macro and Micro Data - Machete.csv", header=TRUE)
```

```{r}
#Contingency table for chi square: Tool x Macro-Edge 1 Regularity (MacroE1R)
table_TxMacroE1R<-xtabs(~Tool+Macro_Edge_1_Regularity, Macro_Micro_Data_Machete)
addmargins(table_TxMacroE1R)
set.seed(42) 
chi_TxMacroE1R<-chisq.test(table_TxMacroE1R, correct = FALSE)
chi_TxMacroE1R
chi_TxMacroE1R[["residuals"]] 
options(scipen=10)
Assocs(table_TxMacroE1R)
```

```{r}
#Contingency table for chi square: Tool x Macro-Edge 2 Feathering (MacroE2Feather)
table_TxMacroE2Feather<-xtabs(~Tool+Macro_Edge_2_Feathering, Macro_Micro_Data_Machete)
addmargins(table_TxMacroE2Feather)
set.seed(42) 
chi_TxMacroE2Feather<-chisq.test(table_TxMacroE2Feather, correct = FALSE)
chi_TxMacroE2Feather
chi_TxMacroE2Feather[["residuals"]] 
options(scipen=10)
# Cramer's V for Tool x Macro-Edge 2 Feathering
n <- sum(table_TxMacroE2Feather)

cramers_v_TxMacroE2Feather <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(chi_TxMacroE2Feather$statistic) /
    (n * min(nrow(table_TxMacroE2Feather) - 1,
             ncol(table_TxMacroE2Feather) - 1))
)

cramers_v_TxMacroE2Feather
 
```
